name: Apollo BP-13
about: Apollo BP-13 (1964-025A), a crewed vehicle (Apollo BPS), launched 1964 May 28. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (AR).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (1964 May 30), held fixed
